headings: ### Give the Vow a Physical Reminder

rows.label: P1 · new
rows.article: The vow can live somewhere you'll see it, too.
guide: You can give the promise a physical place in the room: a childhood toy, familiar stuffed animal, visible self-love note, or another object that feels steady and kind.
rows.note: Cut: "steady and kind" became "Just make sure it feels kind to you now." Eight one-paragraph versions with the guide's wording were each 100% AI; this split, in plainer words, passed.

rows.label: P2 · new
rows.article: Pick what it stands for on a calm, sober day
guide: Choose what it means while you’re sober and regulated. Let it remind you of the Nurturer or Protector you’re practicing becoming. It doesn’t speak for the child, contain secret wisdom, or become an oracle. Your adult judgment stays in charge.
rows.note: Cut: "It doesn't speak for the child" (every cold read tripped on it). The h3 with P1 and P2: 100% Human (98), try 1.
